question: How much of my income should I save?
answer: There is no single right amount. Start with what you can keep up every time money comes in. Even a small fixed amount builds the habit. Increase it when your income rises.

question: What can I do if an ajo collector ran away with our money?
answer: Gather all members and every record of payment. Report to the police and to the community or market leaders who know the collector. Next time join only groups with known members and written records.
